THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
098
Behind the image
75 / Caramel Coat
REFERENCE 5936.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 054
Art direction: Tonal caramel and tawny browns, a warm wood-panel backdrop, rich fuzzy and
suede textures and an even, cool floor.
Photorealistic full-length vertical fashion portrait of an original adult woman with very long,
straight dark hair blowing gently across her face, a calm, direct gaze and a composed expression.
She wears a long caramel-brown shaggy knit coat with an oversized shawl collar and ribbed cuffs,
worn open over a fitted brown suede-look mini dress with a gold sequin trim at the neckline and
hem and small gold buttons. Cream ribbed socks, tall black lace-up leather boots with buckle
straps. Warm honey-toned wood-panel wall, soft even studio light, cool grey-green floor,
monochrome caramel and brown palette, tactile fur and suede texture, autumn fashion editorial,
no text or logos.
76 / Smocked Denim
REFERENCE 5938.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 054
Art direction: Tonal blues from the denim to the backdrop, a soft, slightly angled pose and clean,
even studio light.
Photorealistic vertical studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman in a low, crouched pose
with one hand resting near her chin, long dark wavy hair falling over her shoulders, soft blush, a
calm, slightly pensive gaze and soft rosy lips. She wears an off-the-shoulder smocked top in
washed mid-blue denim-look fabric with ruffled edges and thin straps, a matching denim-look
mini skirt with a soft wash, and black mesh Mary Jane flats. Seamless deep blue studio backdrop,
soft even light with gentle shadows, tonal blue palette, crisp fabric texture, clean summer editorial,
no text or logos.
